barRaise.topFinding: First full lens pass since 2026-07-19, forced by two docs commits landing today (2931376, 1780376) that closed the phantom-pointer drift the 07-24 canonical audit found. Both hard_rule_checks re-pass: all three secrets are gitignored and app.js was last written by the v0.57.0 release commit b2eebce, so no hand edit. The money path is unchanged and still gates the verdict: compliance-01 (openBillingPortal returns early on CHAINS_VISIBLE = false at src/subscription.ts:280, so the live Manage/cancel button does nothing, open 21 runs) and auth-01 (billing routes trust body.userId, worker/src/handlers/billing.js:53, open 18 runs) are both re-confirmed in the current source. New this run: tools/audit_dashboard.py parses zero findings out of a report holding three, so the dashboard audit block is lying by omission and the guard built to stop exactly that masking is itself the thing masking. Health 86, verdict needs-attention on the functional breakages, not the score band.

actions.title: Re-gate openBillingPortal() on PRO_PAYWALL_ENABLED not CHAINS_VISIBLE so the live cancel button works (src/subscription.ts:280).

Widen the _SEV_RX severity parser in tools/audit_dashboard.py to the heading-suffix and parenthesized forms the audit reports actually use, and fail loudly when a populated Drift-found section parses to all-zero.
Verify the Supabase access-token JWT on the billing and AI-spend routes and derive userId from the verified claim instead of trusting body.userId (lib.js:1717, billing.js:53).
Add a Stripe->Supabase reconciliation cron and handle charge.refunded/dispute so a dropped webhook or refund cannot strand or over-grant entitlement (billing.js:640-693).
Harden the Stripe webhook: gate checkout.session on payment_status=paid, dedupe on event.id, store stripe_subscription_id, stop 200-ACKing a missing profile (billing.js:656-690).
Add a Subscription and Billing plus refund/cancellation section to the terms that backs the Cancel-anytime modal copy (legal/terms.md, src/subscription.ts:209).
Finalize an effective date, drop the DRAFT banner, and add a payment/subscription clause to the served terms (src/legal-view.ts:295).
Convert the KV cost-cap counters to an atomic primitive so concurrent requests cannot overshoot the caps (billing.js:104-218).
Lock a dunning decision and add the past_due branch to _checkSubscriptionEntitled and is_entitled() (lib.js:1691, migrations/0018:60).
Add a short-TTL positive-entitlement cache and fix the fail-open/closed comment so a transient Supabase blip does not lock out paying users (lib.js:1685).
Apply the global DAILY_AI_SPEND_CAP_USD guard-and-accrual to handleExtractPhotosReal and handleParseCourseText and cap photos[] length (research.js:38,131).
Persist starred-course canonical detail to localStorage so an offline round shows real hole/pin data, not a par-3 skeleton (src/persistence.ts:162, sw.js).
Block checkout when a subscription is already active and send a Stripe idempotency key so a double-tap cannot create a second live subscription (billing.js:566-604).
Give bags/discs/collection the same id-keyed union-merge-with-tombstones that rounds use so a stale device cannot delete rows it never loaded (src/cloud.ts:855).
